findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: product, shopping, search, seller, serp, bestsellers, offers, keyword_rankings, product_keywords, batch · Private data: product, shopping, search, seller, serp, bestsellers, offers, deals, brand, category, list_tracked, batch, account · Public sink: shopping, seller, brand, category, track_product, batch · Destructive: product, shopping, serp, bestsellers, offers, deals, list_tracked, batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: product, shopping, search, seller, serp, bestsellers, offers, keyword_rankings, product_keywords, batch · Private data: product, shopping, search, seller, serp, bestsellers, offers, deals, brand, category, list_tracked, batch, account · Public sink: shopping, seller, brand, category, track_product, batch · Destructive: product, shopping, serp, bestsellers, offers, deals, list_tracked, batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
